release.audience: senior engineers and hands-on engineering leads using coding agents

claims.statement: ADLC gives a coding agent repeatable Build, Fix, and read-only Review loops whose completion claims are tied to evidence.
limitations: A loop can stop blocked or awaiting human approval; evidence does not guarantee future provider behavior.

claims.statement: The exact recorded Codex Fix configuration earned a beta label from three passing runs and an independent three-run replay.
limitations: The label applies only to the named provider, model, harness, loop, source commit, fixture, and dimensions.

claims.statement: The release preparation path builds the wheel and source archive twice, compares exact digests, audits dependencies, installs cleanly, and rehearses rollback before approval.
limitations: Candidate preparation is not evidence that PyPI, GitHub Release, or Pages publication succeeded.

claims.statement: Beta activation metrics are calculated locally and telemetry remains off unless an operator explicitly opts in to a future reviewed exporter.
limitations: No hosted telemetry endpoint or adoption dataset exists in this beta packet.

communications.release_announcement: ADLC 0.9.1 beta packages repeatable Build, Fix, and Review loops around an existing coding agent, with a public Fix benchmark and explicit evidence and approval boundaries.
communications.github_release_draft: Try the five-minute Fix path, inspect the six-run benchmark bundle, and file sanitized beta feedback. This is an evidence-scoped beta, not GA.
communications.social_draft: A coding agent can produce a diff. ADLC 0.9.1 beta focuses on the harder question: what was actually proved? See the reproducible Fix demo and its limitations.
communications.community_draft: We are opening an approval-gated ADLC beta for engineers who want resumable, evidence-bound coding-agent loops. Feedback is welcome through the beta issue template.

funnel.success: first Build or Fix reaches pr_ready with evidence
same project starts another eligible loop within 7 days

rollback_triggers.condition: public artifact contains a credential, private path, or private target-repository content
rollback_triggers.action: stop launch, remove exposure through the security process, and rotate affected credentials

rollback_triggers.condition: published bytes or documentation do not match the approved tag and packet
rollback_triggers.action: stop communication, mark the release affected, and follow the release rollback runbook

rollback_triggers.condition: a reproducible severity-1 defect affects install, approval enforcement, or evidence integrity
rollback_triggers.action: pause intake expansion and publish corrective guidance only after approval

rollback_triggers.condition: severity-2 acknowledgement misses its target twice in one review week
rollback_triggers.action: hold cohort expansion until ownership and backlog return within bounds

doc_honesty_section: This packet prepares final-form beta assets and local learning contracts; it is not evidence of publication, adoption, or external review approval.
no_overclaim: ADLC does not claim GA, traction, universal provider support, enterprise readiness, autonomous delivery, or guaranteed future agent behavior.
limitations: Live behavioral evidence covers only the exact Codex Fix configuration named in the support matrix.
Telemetry and hosted analytics are absent; beta metrics require operator-local records.
Every package, release, Pages, and communication action remains human-approval-bound.
